refnamediv.refpurpose: Function to set up an in-language function

refsection.title: Description
refsection.para: The SilikoFunctionCreate function creates a SilikoFunction objecr with source_table as its SilikoFunctionVTable and source_state as its state object.

refsection.title: Return Values
refsection.para: SilikoFunctionCreate returns a pointer to the newly created object if successful, or NULL if there is an error. If SilikoFunctionCreate returns a valid pointer, then the object must be passed to SilikoFunctionDestroy to avoid a memory error, and source_state will be cleaned up when the object is passed to SilikoFunctionDestroy. If SilikoFunctionCreate returns NULL, then the calling context is still responsible for cleaning up source_state.
